columns.name: Data Extract - As Of Date
columns.description: The specific date when data was obtained or retrieved from a source for the purpose of analysis and reporting

columns.name: Department (Code)
columns.description: Code associated with the City department as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems

columns.name: Department (Description)
columns.description: Description associated with the City department as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems

columns.name: Department (Code - Description)
columns.description: Code and description associated with the City department as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems

columns.name: Composite Fund (Code)
columns.description: Code associated with the Composite Fund. The Composite Fund combines multiple projects or activities under a single application

columns.name: Composite Fund (Description)
columns.description: Also known as Composite Fund Name.  The Composite Fund combines multiple projects or activities under a single application

columns.name: Composite Fund (Code - Description)
columns.description: Code associated with the Composite Fund along with a description of the Composite Fund (i.e., Fund Name).

columns.name: Fund (Code)
columns.description: Code associated with the Fund. Designated with the Budget Ordinance and aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: Fund (Description)
columns.description: Also known as Fund Name. Description of the Fund. Designated with the Budget Ordinance and aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: Fund (Code - Description)
columns.description: Code associated with the Fund along with a description of the Fund (i.e., Fund Name). Designated with the Budget Ordinance and aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: Parent Cost Center (Code)
columns.description: A unique Higher-level organizational unit identifier that may encompass multiple sub-cost centers

columns.name: Grant Project (Code)
columns.description: Unique code associated with any specific grant award received by the City

columns.name: Grant Project (Description)
columns.description: Description of any grant award received by the City

columns.name: Grant Start Date
columns.description: Start date of grant project

columns.name: Grant End Date
columns.description: End date of grant project

columns.name: Grant Agency
columns.description: Name of grant agency

columns.name: ALN (Code)
columns.description: Assistance Listing Number for Federal Grants

columns.name: Budget
columns.description: The specific sum of money allocated for a specific purpose, project or period

columns.name: Encumbrances
columns.description: The total amount of money that has been set aside or committed for a future expense, but not yet incurred

columns.name: Expended (Project To Date)
columns.description: The total amount of money that has been spent by each program at the time the report is generated

columns.name: Funds Available (Project To Date)
columns.description: The total amount of money that is immediately available for use

columns.name: Record ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each record.
